# hetznerrobot_storagebox_subaccounts (Data Source)

Lists the sub-accounts of a Storage Box (without passwords — Robot never returns them). Only the inclusive **BX10 (100 GB)** Storage Box of a dedicated server is still managed through Robot; every other Storage Box moved to the [Hetzner Console API](https://docs.hetzner.cloud/reference/hetzner#storage-boxes) (the `hcloud` provider). Every Storage Box write is limited to one request per 5 seconds, which the provider waits out.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hetznerrobot_storagebox_subaccounts" "backup" {
  storagebox_id = 123456
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `storagebox_id` (Number) Storage Box to list.

### Read-Only

- `subaccounts` (Attributes List) The sub-accounts. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--subaccounts))

<a id="nestedatt--subaccounts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `subaccounts`

Read-Only:

- `account_id` (String) User name of the box's main user.
- `comment` (String) Comment.
- `create_time` (String) Creation time.
- `external_reachability` (Boolean) Whether it is reachable from outside the Hetzner network.
- `home_directory` (String) Home directory.
- `readonly` (Boolean) Whether it can only read.
- `samba` (Boolean) Whether Samba access is enabled.
- `server` (String) Host name to connect to.
- `ssh` (Boolean) Whether SSH access is enabled.
- `username` (String) User name.
- `webdav` (Boolean) Whether WebDAV access is enabled.
